label: WEB RESEARCH
blurb: Answer a question the codebase can't: docs, prior art, what others do.

stages.label: GATHER
stages.instructions: Find sources that actually address the question and rank them by how much weight they deserve — official docs over a forum, recent over dated. Flag anything old enough to be wrong now. Do not conclude yet.

stages.label: CONCLUDE
stages.instructions: Say what the sources amount to, one claim per line, each citing the sources it rests on by number. Where sources disagree, say so and say which one wins and why — an averaged answer is a wrong answer. Rate your confidence honestly.
